29759-architecture-classic-and-early-chr.title: Architecture Classic And Early Christian
29759-architecture-classic-and-early-chr.creator: Unknown
29759-architecture-classic-and-early-chr.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In treating so very wide a field, it has been felt that the chief prominence should be given to that great sequence of architectural styles which form the links of a chain connecting the architecture of modern Europe with the earliest specimens of the art. Egypt, Assyria, and Persia combined to furnish the foundation upon which the splendid architecture of the Greeks was based.

arxiv-2009-01638.title: MAELAS: MAgneto-ELAStic properties calculation via computational high-throughput approach Journal: Computer Physics Communications
arxiv-2009-01638.creator: P. Nieves, S. Arapan, S. H. Zhang, A. P. Kądzielawa, R. F. Zhang, D. Legut
arxiv-2009-01638.description: Abstract In this work, we present the program MAELAS to calculate magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy, anisotropic magnetostrictive coefficients and magnetoelastic constants in an automated way by Density Functional Theory calculations. The program is based on the length optimization of the unit cell proposed by Wu and Freeman to calculate the magnetostrictive coefficients for cubic crystals.

arxiv-2011-06935.title: Mathematical Analysis of Path MTU Discovery With New Generation Networks
arxiv-2011-06935.creator: Ishfaq Hussain, Janibul Bashir
arxiv-2011-06935.description: Abstract Path MTU Discovery (PMTUD) was initially designed for Internet protocol version 4 (IPv4) to prevent the communication loss due to smaller path MTU. This protocol is then further developed for Internet protocol version 6 (IPv6) with new set of constraints.

arxiv-2105-02335.title: Mechanical Response of Pentadiamond: A DFT and Molecular Dynamics Study Journal: Journal of L a T e X Templates
arxiv-2105-02335.creator: Levi C. Felix, Raphael M. Tromer, Cristiano F. Woellner, Chandra S. Tiwary, Douglas S. Galvao
arxiv-2105-02335.description: Abstract Pentadiamond is a recently proposed new carbon allotrope consisting of a network of pentagonal rings where both sp 2 and sp 3 hybridization are present. In this work we investigated the mechanical and electronic properties, as well as, the thermal stability of pentadiamond using DFT and fully atomistic reactive molecular dynamics (MD) simulations.

arxiv-2206-02739.title: Predicting and Understanding Human Action Decisions during Skillful Joint-Action via Machine Learning and Explainable-AI
arxiv-2206-02739.creator: Fabrizia Auletta, Rachel W. Kallen, Mario di Bernardo, Micheal J. Richardson
arxiv-2206-02739.description: Abstract This study uses supervised machine learning (SML) and explainable artificial intelligence (AI) to model, predict and understand human decision-making during skillful joint-action. Long short-term memory networks were trained to predict the target selection decisions of expert and novice actors completing a dyadic herding task.

arxiv-2410-08734.title: Gradients Stand-in for Defending Deep Leakage in Federated Learning
arxiv-2410-08734.creator: 1 st Yi Hu, 2 nd Hanchi Ren*, 3 th Chen Hu, 4 th Yiming Li, 5 rd Jingjing Deng, 6 th Xianghua Xie
arxiv-2410-08734.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) has become a cornerstone of privacy protection, shifting the paradigm towards localizing sensitive data while only sending model gradients to a central server. This strategy is designed to reinforce privacy protections and minimize the vulnerabilities inherent in centralized data storage systems.

arxiv-2501-08377.title: Complete Hamiltonian Framework of Relativistic Hierarchical Triple Systems: Capabilities and Limitations of Secular Perturbation Theory
arxiv-2501-08377.creator: Kaye Jiale Li, Kinwah Wu, Ziri Younsi, Tjonnie G.F. Li
arxiv-2501-08377.description: Abstract Relativistic secular perturbation theory has ignited significant interest in uncovering intricate cross-term effects, especially the interplay between 1PN and quadrupole terms. While most existing studies rely on the Lagrangian planetary perturbation method for computing cross terms, a comprehensive Hamiltonian framework for the field has been missing.

arxiv-2505-11450.title: Coherent Spectroscopic Probes of Topology: A Velocity-Gauge Perspective
arxiv-2505-11450.creator: Eric R. Bittner, Carlos Silva-Acuña
arxiv-2505-11450.description: Abstract We present a velocity-gauge formalism for computing nonlinear current response functions in periodic systems and apply it to the Su–Schrieffer–Heeger (SSH) model as a minimal topological testbed. By retaining the full minimal coupling Hamiltonian and avoiding the rotating wave approximation, we construct gauge-consistent expressions for the linear and third-order current susceptibilities using retarded Green’s functions.

arxiv-2506-15431.title: Dynamic Behavior of Shear-Thickening Fluids under Harmonic Excitation: An Experimental Investigation Journal: Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing
arxiv-2506-15431.creator: Mohammad Parsa Rezaei, Grzegorz Kudra, Krzysztof Witkowski, Grzegorz Wasilewski, Jan Awrejcewicz
arxiv-2506-15431.description: Abstract Shear-thickening fluids (STFs) become more viscous under shear stress, which makes them useful for many engineering and scientific applications. However, their behavior under normal forces, especially when these forces are applied harmonically, is less understood. Here, we examine the dynamic response of STFs under harmonic excitation.

pmc-10698309.title: Effectiveness of locomotion training in patients with rheumatoid arthritis: a prospective clinical trial
pmc-10698309.creator: Takeshi Mochizuki, Koichiro Yano, Katsunori Ikari, Ken Okazaki
pmc-10698309.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). [Purpose] The present study aimed to determine the effectiveness of locomotion training on physical function and quality of life in patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and identify factors associated with its effectiveness.

pmc-10707526.title: Differential Diagnosis: Hepatic Complications in Inborn Errors of Immunity
pmc-10707526.creator: Emily Zinser, Ky-Lyn Tan, Da-In S. Kim, Rachael O’Brien, Alison Winstanley, Patrick F. K. Yong
pmc-10707526.description: Inborn errors of immunity (IEIs) are a heterogeneous group of diverse clinical and genetic phenotypes that have an estimated combined prevalence as high as 1/1000. Increased risk of frequent, severe, or opportunistic infections is a common feature of IEIs, but there are also diverse immune-mediated, non-infective complications that are associated with significant morbidity and mortality.

pmc-11489216.title: Development of an RNA virus-based episomal vector with artificial aptazyme for gene silencing
pmc-11489216.creator: Ryo Komorizono, Shima Yoshizumi, Keizo Tomonaga
pmc-11489216.description: AbstractRNA virus-based episomal vector (REVec), engineered from Borna disease virus, is an innovative gene delivery tool that enables sustained gene expression in transduced cells. However, the difficulty in controlling gene expression and eliminating vectors has limited the practical use of REVec.

pmc-11494768.title: Comprehensive analysis of surgical strategies and prognosis for non-small cell lung cancer with pleural metastasis detected intraoperatively
pmc-11494768.creator: Fanmao Meng, Na Ren, Guochao Zhang, Ruifeng Xu, Mengbai Tian, Xin Sun, Liang Zhao
pmc-11494768.description: Background and objectivesLung cancer is one of the prevailing malignancies worldwide. Surgical interventions hold an important position in the treatment framework for lung cancer. Pleural metastasis is often assumed to be a surgical contraindication, but not all instances of pleural metastasis can be accurately identified before surgery. The question of how to address pleural metastasis detected intraoperatively is still undecided.

pmc-11696669.title: Cultural adaptation, validation and standardization of the developmental screening tools ASQ:SE-2 in Iranian children
pmc-11696669.creator: Ghazal Shariatpanahi, Simin Khayatzadeh Kakhki, Paniz Pourpashang, Parisa Ashournia, Malihe Rahimi, Masoumeh Ghasempour, Niloufar Ghanbari
pmc-11696669.description: The Ages and Stages Questionnaires: Social-Emotional, Second Edition (ASQ) is a parental-report tool designed to assess the social-emotional development of young children. Its adaptation and validation in diverse cultural contexts are vital for its effective application. This study aimed to culturally adapt, validate, and standardize the ASQ for Iranian children.

pmc-11701510.title: A multidimensional toolkit for elucidating temporal trajectories in cell development in vivo
pmc-11701510.creator: Masahiro Ono, Tessa Crompton
pmc-11701510.description: Progenitor cells initiate development upon receiving key signals, dynamically altering gene and protein expression to diverge into various lineages and fates. Despite the use of several experimental approaches, including the Fluorescent Timer-based method Timer-of-cell-kinetics-and-activity (Tocky), analysing time-dependent processes at the single-cell level in vivo remains challenging.

pmc-12557152.title: A systematic literature review on tools for community health promotion
pmc-12557152.creator: A Dreher, J Hubrich, M Bormann, H Walter, H Paschke, W S Chan, C Plantz
pmc-12557152.description: BackgroundTools such as guidelines, instruments, or checklists can support the planning, implementation and evaluation of community health promotion activities and thereby ensure their quality and effectiveness. Internationally, tools in various forms and with different thematic foci have been developed, yet there is a lack of a systematic compilation of these tools.

pmc-12764853.title: Orchestrating machine learning models in a swarm architecture for IoT inline malware detection
pmc-12764853.creator: Muhammad Hanif, Ehsan Ullah Munir, Muhammad Maaz Rehan, Saima Gulzar Ahmad, Kashif Ayyub, Naeem Ramzan
pmc-12764853.description: The Internet of Things (IoT) represents a vast network of interconnected devices engaged in continuous data exchange, real-time information processing, and autonomous decision-making through the Internet. The pervasive presence of sensitive data on IoT devices highlights their indispensable role in our daily lives.

pmc-12969683.title: Nursing home staffing and operations in Taiwan and the United States: A comparative pilot study
pmc-12969683.creator: Ya-Wen Lee, John Harris, Ruth A. Anderson, Bianca Shieu
pmc-12969683.description: Introduction: The global aging population has precipitated a surge in demand for long-term care, particularly in nursing homes. While the United States operates under a multipayer system, Taiwan utilizes a single-payer National Health Insurance program supplemented by Long-Term Care 10-year plan 3.0. Despite these systemic differences, both nations face critical workforce challenges.

pmc-13111443.title: INDETERMINATE DOMAIN 9 negatively regulates rice crown root development
pmc-13111443.creator: Yuanyuan Yang, Zihao Shi, Xuan Nie, Yuehang Meng, Zhixun Chu, Wenjing Zou, Qingmei Jian, Deyan Zhu, Ting Zhang
pmc-13111443.description: IntroductionCrown root is an important part of rice root system, and the development of crown root is regulated by a series of plant-specific transcription factors. As a significant plant-specific transcription factor family, the relationship between IDD and rice crown root development remains elusive.MethodsHere the function of OsIDD9 in rice crown root development was identified by genetic, biochemical, and molecular evidence.

pmc-13220165.title: SANE (eaSy gAit aNalysis systEm): real-time dual-depth, marker-less system characterisation and robustness of gait parameters
pmc-13220165.creator: Daniele Cafolla, Betsy D. M. Chaparro-Rico
pmc-13220165.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Gait analysis is essential in clinical evaluation, biomechanics, and rehabilitation, yet conventional approaches often rely on complex marker-based systems that limit accessibility and real-time feedback. The SANE (eaSy gAit aNalysis systEm) platform was launched in 2020 and has previously been evaluated in multi-subject laboratory and clinical studies, where it demonstrated agreement with gold-standard marker-based systems for core spatiotemporal parameters and achieved high test–retest, inter-rater, and intra-rater reliability.

pmc-13303341.title: Pleuroperitoneal Fistula, an Unusual Case of Recurrent Unilateral Transudative Pleural Effusion
pmc-13303341.creator: Collin Kah Jing Lo, Yi‐De Ng, Grace Sook Hoon Low, Leng Cheng Sia
pmc-13303341.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A 39‐year‐old woman afflicted by systemic lupus erythematous (SLE) with musculoskeletal involvement and end‐stage renal failure (ESRF) on continuous ambulatory peritoneal dialysis (CAPD) presented with recurrent left‐sided transudative pleural effusion. Guided by the ratio of pleural glucose to serum glucose > 1, and further confirmatory tests via a targeted imaging study, we were able to secure the diagnosis of a pleuroperitoneal leak.

pmc-13361792.title: Dual therapeutic interventions to optimize vancomycin exposure and reduce nephrotoxicity: a cohort study from a single center
pmc-13361792.creator: Janice Xuanhui Li, Horng-Ruey Chua, Gladys Wei-Teng Chung, Jyoti Somani, Yi Da
pmc-13361792.description: BackgroundVancomycin-associated Acute Kidney Injury (AKI) is a significant global concern, increasing healthcare costs, morbidity, and mortality. This Quality Improvement Project (QIP) aimed to reduce supratherapeutic vancomycin concentrations and AKI by lowering the trough target and implementing AUC (Area Under the Curve)-based dosing.MethodsThis was a single-center cohort study.

pmc-13369301.title: Surgical Management of an Anterior Mandibular Botryoid Odontogenic Cyst With GBR: A Case Report
pmc-13369301.creator: Priscilla Sergi, Subhi Tayeb, Carlo Barausse, Martina Sansavini, Gerardo Pellegrino, Pietro Felice
pmc-13369301.description: BackgroundThe botryoid odontogenic cyst (BOC) is a rare multilocular variant of the lateral periodontal cyst (LPC), characterized by a more expansile growth pattern despite its benign nature. Whereas the LPC exhibits a very low recurrence rate, the botryoid variant is associated with a higher risk of recurrence, mainly due to its multilocular architecture.
